title: Multimedia Journalism
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 16S/24Q to fewer than 30S/45Q units

not_verbatim: Understand and apply ethical principles and legal considerations specific to journalism to produce well-researched, compelling multimedia stories using a combination of text, images, audio, and video to effectively communicate information to diverse audiences, with an emphasis on clarity, accuracy, and journalistic style.

Demonstrate an understanding of the importance of diversity and inclusion in journalism, reflecting it in coverage and story selection to represent a broad range of perspectives, while working collaboratively in a newsroom setting and demonstrating effective communication and teamwork skills essential for the dynamic and fast-paced nature of journalism.

Compile a comprehensive and professional portfolio showcasing a range of journalistic work across different media formats and disciplines, including written copy, digital media, and photography, demonstrating growth and proficiency over the course of the program.
